title: Q-LESSON-CRED-SCOPE: Token scopes are an allowlist; auth paths are normalized
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** grep:seed/worker/src/auth/index.js::SCOPE_ALLOWLIST
**Status:** closed

LESSONS-1 (2026-11-16): from the failure-mode register of the fleet this org was split from (638 entries, classified by root cause).

24 failure modes were credentials: committed secrets, a 22-scope token, an auth bypass through path normalization.

Path: seed/worker/src/auth/index.js

Acceptance: a test asserts the GitHub App's requested permissions equal an allowlist, and an auth test covers path variants (//x, /x/, encoded slashes).

size: S

**Closing probe:** grep:seed/worker/src/auth/index.js::SCOPE_ALLOWLIST

**Evidence:** seed/worker/src/auth/index.js exports SCOPE_ALLOWLIST (frozen GitHub App permissions), used by routes.js manifest default_permissions; canonicalPath + pathGuard redirect (308) //x, /x/, %2F, %252F, %5C and dot-segment variants to the canonical path, called first in index.js fetch. Tests: seed/worker/test/auth.test.js 'the GitHub App requests exactly SCOPE_ALLOWLIST...', 'canonicalPath folds...', 'pathGuard redirects...', 'the worker runs pathGuard before any route...'.
